posts.name: Bowie
posts.cooked:
@Bowie - Oh no! There is a horde of angry ninjas with big stabby sticks rushing toward you. You must defeat them and are armed only with an origami swan. What do you do?

Oh, this one’s really easy!

So, first, I hold up the origami swan, while crying big, crocodile tears. “PLEASE DON’T KILL ME. ALL I HAVE IS THIS SWAN.” And then one pauses, holding a hand to the rest, as he approaches me. Gingerly, he considers the swan, then lifts it from my fingers. On my knees, blubbering, I whisper ‘thankyouthankyouthankyou’, assuming he has accepted this as an offering. Tears begin to thin, and I look up through the blur of my own fear-cursed sobs, and I see his eyes narrow into slits as he crushes the origami swan in his hand.
“I see you’ve made cuts. This is not true origami,” he whispers, seething with rage.
“Well, I… I’m not good at origami,” I whisper, smelling my own fear, now, as it seeps down my leg.
“I shall make cuts, too,” he snarls and then that hand, still held up in the ‘hold’ position for his ninja horde, closes into a fist. The horde swoops in, like dark knives in shadows, and I sob again until my voice is suddenly silenced.

I die, really, really hard. Just, no contest.

A murder mystery, with all the heroes in the mansion....

Maia Montgomery's grandfather invites the Freedom Five and other various heroes to a dinner party in their honor, for all the work they've done.  However, shortly after a beautiful banquet dinner, her grandfather is found dead, in the study.  The heroes immediately set out to find out who-done-it.  After a few hours of investigation they decide on their first suspect:  Setback!  However, they soon discover that at the time of the murder, he was in the garden, tangled in weeds.  But, while he was there, he discovered an important clue that eventually lead them to the true suspect.  The butler!  He was after grandpa Montgomery's money!  Once the butler is captured by the heroes, they discover that Maia's grandfather wasn't dead after all!  Knowing someone was out to get him, and knowing that the authorities were corrupt (thanks, Chairman!), he needed others involved (the heroes).  He also had a life-model-decoy (tm, Marvel) created of himself that was "assassinated" in the study.  Now the life-model-decoy lives out its repaired life as his new butler.  Little does Grandpa Montgomery know, the robot is now upset for having been used as a dupe for a murder.  Knowing that under Grandpa Montgomery's ownership, they will often be used as a target, the decoy wishes to get out from under his thumb....even if it requires murder!

First of all, this post is obsenely long. I'm sorry, sort of. I decided since I'm going to write another narrative, I'm going to go ahead and make it a sequel to a story answer I wrote on this thread probably a couple of years ago. You should read some of the older posts, they're quite funny.

"In the year 2021, Sentinels of the Multiverse has become an international sensation. For a while, it was a golden era of prosperity as nations learned to come together and team up to fight the villains of poverty and hunger instead of always fighting for each other. Alas, the peace ended as schisms between different play groups developed. Arguments erupted all around the world as people fought over who was the best hero and what house rules could be added to make the game better.

North America was split in half from the two largest warring factions led by the accursed Ronway and the deceptively delicious Brocolli.The accursed Ronway led the side that demanded that no house rules ever be added for they were unnecessary and spoiled the game. Although his main power base was in the states, he had a presence in England due to a shared hatred of house rules that was shared with the influential Silverleaf and Matchstickman. The deceptively delicious Brocolli was of the side that house rules were okay but games using them should probably not be recorded in the statistics. he also had a very strong foothold in the States as well as strong supporters in England because of an alliance with the corrupted Deputy of the Greater than Games initiative, Arenson 9. The war started when Brocolli was assasinated by the nemesis of all deceptively delicious vegetables, the sneaky Rabit.

The followers of Brocolli blamed the brotherhood of the Ronway for their leader's demise and left the world of internet forums and retaliated with guns and knives. The elusive Rabit was never caught or brought to justice. He and and his friend Pydro watched the conflict from space in the Marot's Folly ready to profit off the inevitable war.

The deadliest weapon that the Ronways had in their arsenal were their phalanxes of phantom clowns that would terrorize the populace in their creepy masks and cloaks. The last words their victims would hear as they lay dying in pools of their own blood were, "Fixer is a great hero."

Oddly enough two of the most powerful and influential members of the world wide Sentinels network, Nielzabub and Reckless, did not join the war as everyone expected. They hid out in a small unknown island in Japan waiting for the right moment to intervene. By the time the war ended they would end up eating 6,712 Bananae.

In the end, Ronway was betrayed by his British friends when audio of him blaming England for all of the world's problems and that he was planning to betray them after he had quelled the deceptively delicious Brocolli's followers was released. Matchstickman and Silverleaf assasinated the dreaded Ronway and took over his army of deadly, creepy clowns.

The Broccolites unleased their deadliest weapon, a bomb. Everyone had forgotten those things existed and were really caught by surprise. The Ronways remembered that they too probably had bombs somewhere and thus the world became a wasteland. Nielzabub and Reckless returned from their self imposed exile and began preaching the world over the true value of Sentinels. They dedicated themselves to reminding people that the game was supposed to bring us together and not tear us apart. The world learned its lesson and Sentinels once again brought about an age of harmony and understanding."

I'll admit that it's self indulgent, but Christopher still gave me a squid hat for it.

  • @Nielzabub - Your sworn enemy is coming at you with their combination of heroes, playable forumites, and team-converted villains. The total number of characters adds up to 5. Natuarally, you get your choice as well. Who do you choose and what happens? (A combo of everything, or only heroes, or only villains, or only forumites. You choose. And they aren't cameos, just forumites.  EX: Unity, Pydro, Apostate, Nielzabub, Greazer.)

For over twenty years the world had been at peace. Nielzabub and Reckless had once again secluded themselves from the world content with the results of their work. They were old now, and they were ready for retirement. From space, a new threat emerged. Rabit and Pydro had returned to Earth with the Marot's Folly. They looked upon the world and realized their plans had failed. Rabit slammed his fist on the console, there weren't even any deceptively delicious vegetables left to brighten his mood. Pydro thought for a moment, and an idea entered his head. The hyperdrive on the ship could theoretically do more than rip open holes in space but also dimensions. He knew exactly what to do.

Nielzabub and Reckless were on their small island playing a game of Sentinels when a hole opened in the sky.A ship which Nielzabub and Reckless felt they should recognize but had trouble remembering flew a bit over the hole. Maniacal laughter filled the air as Baron Blade emerged from the portal standing on top of a mobile defense platform. Joining him were Citizen Dawn and Grand Warlord Voss.

Baron Blade stroked his beard. "So, they worship our enemies in this world? We will see about that?"

Voss and Dawn agreed with a smile, they were ready to conquer a defenseless world and remake it in their image.

Nielzabub and Reckless looked at each other and sighed. Peace was always a fleeting thing. It was time to fight again. They needed to stop this menace here and now. They put on their jetpacks and flew to the Mobile Defense Platform ready to take this menace head on even if it meant their lives.

The villains were unimpressed as Nielzabub and Reckless descended onto the platform.

Voss cracked his knuckles. "You two are only humans. What could you possibly hope to achieve?"

Dawn shot a warning shot of energy between the two forumites. "This world shall be ruled by the strong."

Nielzabub and Reckless did not falter. They knew this fight may be their last, but they were determined to do all they could.The three villains scattered as a missle headed toward them. From the sky in powered armor flew down UXM266. Like Nielzabub and Reckless, he too had been a veteran of the earlier forum wars. He had prepared for the day when war would once again enter the world.

Things were starting to look up, but even with UXM's help, the three forumites were still outmatched.

"You will not conquer any worlds, Blade!" Legacy flew out of the portal and punched Voss in the face.

"Yeah, and you're not taking any of their snacks either!" Tachyon shot out of the portal at supersonic speed and punched Dawn into a wall temporarily disabling her. Tachyon looked at the gathered forumites. "From what I can tell, the portal is being created by that ship. If you destroy the source of the portal, everything that doesn't belong in this dimension will return to where it belongs."

As Voss started to get back up, Legacy punched him in the face again. "We'll handle the villains as best we can, but hurry, we won't be able to hold them off forever."

UXM, Reckless, and Nielzabub nodded and flew to the Marot's Folly where the final battle awaited them. 

They had been expecting the Marot's Folley to be filled with traps and guards, but nothing stopped them from proceeding to their goal. They made it to the bridge, and waiting for them was Rabit and Pydro with a table and a collection of instantly recognizable cards. The fate of all existence was about to be determined by a game of Sentinels, but not just any game, a game of Oblivaeon.

Pydro and Rabit had hopped to a dimension where the final expansion of the game was already completed and awesome. The wager was made, if Nielzabub and his friends won, Pydro and Rabit would shut off the portal and live peacefully on the Earth. If Pydro and Rabit won, the Earth would be handed over to the villains of the multiverse.

The battle was [Redacted]

The sky opened as an even bigger portal opened. With a long flowing beard full of anger and justice, an alternate version of Christopher floated from what seemed the heavens. He came from a world where all humans had evolved beyond the need for physical bodies but still had head and facial hair because it looked cool. The interdimensional playtesting contract had been violated. The Christophers of the Multiverse had all agreed that they could not allow one Christopher's work to influence any other, and by bringing in an outside version of Oblivaeon. With a pen of magic and might, Monitor Christopher closed the breach. The villains, the heroes, and the Marot's Folley along with Pydro and Rabit were pulled through the hole. Nielzabub, Reckless, and UXM were teleported to a beach. With his work done, Monitor Christopher went back into the sky with his own reality breach closing behind him. 

Nielzabub, Reckless, and Uxm all shook hands, agreed the adventure was weird and pointless, and went back to their peaceful lives.
